3d-force-graph v1.80.0 — MIT — https://github.com/vasturiano/3d-force-graph

Vendored rather than loaded from a CDN so the page makes no third-party
requests, keeps working offline, and cannot change underneath us. The bundle
is self-contained: Three.js and d3-force-3d are compiled into it.
